text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Frames 18.0 to 18.8 s. The side-view car moves slowly right and settles lower into the brown floodwater until the wheels are mostly under. Background houses, tree and sign unchanged. Caption holds. Lower third is bare pavement.
